sources.title: kataguru/Kataguru-Sceptic-35B-A3B-Georgian-v3.2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Unlike conventional Continued Pre-Training (CPT) models that overwrite all parameters and degrade mathematical, scientific, and coding intelligence, Kataguru-Sceptic-35B-A3B-Georgian-v3.2 keeps all 254 core Sceptic experts (#0..#253) 100 % frozen and expands each of the 40 MoE layers from 254 -> 256 experts by adding two dedicated Georgian specialist experts (#254 and #255) alongside ...

sources.title: Kataguru-Sceptic-35B-A3B-v2.6-NVFP4 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Kataguru-Sceptic-35B-A3B-v2.6-NVFP4 is a bilingual (English & Finnish) 35-billion parameter (3B active parameters per token, 254 routed experts per layer) multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model quantized to NVIDIA Blackwell NVFP4 (compressed-tensors) with synchronized w13 (gate_proj + up_proj) weight_global_scale across all 10,160 routed experts.
